name: Forge Performance Co
legalEntity: Forge Performance Company LLC dba Forge Performance Co.
businessMailbox: 3801 N Capital of Texas Hwy, Ste E240-3348, Austin, TX 78746
coaAccess: The shop's COA archive and catalog require sign-in. Freedom Diagnostics Testing has a public lookup, and 4 reports were read on its own domain. The shop names Kovera Labs and ILS Laboratories, but no Forge report could be read on those portals in this audit.
dispatchInfo: The shipping policy says orders paid by 12:00 PM CT on weekdays ship the same day from Texas; later, weekend and federal-holiday orders ship the next business day. USPS, UPS or FedEx with tracking. United States only, excluding territories and APO/FPO/DPO addresses.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: All 4 sampled Freedom Diagnostics Testing reports were read on the laboratory domain and name Forge as client; the BPC-157 document also matches the shop-hosted copy byte for byte, but catalog lots were not publicly visible.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: The 4 opened reports measured 110.3%–129.6% of the stated label mass, all above label; this sample does not establish what is currently shipping.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: The reports show HPLC purity, LC-MS identity and net content; some also show endotoxin, microbial PCR, heavy metals and fentanyl screening. A microbial PCR screen alone does not establish sterility.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The Texas Comptroller lists the LLC as active and supplies a registered office, while the shop identifies its published Austin address as a mailbox and does not publish the packing address.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: The published shipping policy states a same-day cutoff, tracked carriers, domestic exclusions and free-shipping thresholds; actual performance was not tested.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: Current prices were not available on the signed-out catalog or sampled live product page.

strengths: 4 Forge reports read on the Freedom Diagnostics Testing domain, including a BPC-157 report identical to the shop copy
Texas entity record matches the company name in the shop's chargeback policy; shipping policy specifies cutoff, carriers and rates
weaknesses: The catalog, live prices and COA archive require sign-in, so the reviewed lots could not be matched to current stock
All 4 opened reports measured above label; the older TB-500 report has no lot identifier
The Austin address published by the shop is a mailbox; the actual packing address is not disclosed
verdict: Forge has a named Texas LLC and a published domestic shipping policy. We read 4 reports on the laboratory's domain, and all measured above label. One matched the shop copy exactly, but the signed-out catalog did not allow us to confirm the lots currently on sale.
summary: Texas research-use shop operated by Forge Performance Company LLC. Its catalog and COA archive require sign-in, but Forge reports are publicly readable through Freedom Diagnostics Testing. The shop states it ships only within the United States.
notes: Report dates are the dates printed as reported, and the product names in report examples are the report names, not verified live listings. GLP RT is left as printed; the certificate does not name a compound beyond that code. The BPC-157 shop PDF publicly resolves, and its product, client and lot match the identical lab PDF; signed-out access did not expose the current catalog lot. The Kovera TB-500 deep link was access denied in the browser; the ILS verifier was readable but asks for a code, and we found no public Forge code. The payment methods are those named in the privacy policy, not a checkout test. The registered office, business mailbox and undisclosed packing address are distinct.
